title_en: Philippine firms order for 15 787-10s
title_zh: 菲律宾公司订购 15 787-10 架

summary_zh: 该交易是菲律宾近二十年来首次直接向波音公司订购。菲律宾航空已敲定 15 架波音 787-10 的订单，确认了
body_en: The deal is Philippine’s first direct Boeing order in nearly two decades.
Philippine Airlines has finalised an order for 15 Boeing 787-10s, firming a commitment it announced in July 2026.
The new aircraft will be powered by GE Aerospace GEnx-1B engines and are scheduled for delivery over the next decade. The carrier has the option to purchase five more as part of the deal.

“The Boeing 787-10 will play an important role in our plans to modernise and expand our fleet. Its advanced technology, greater passenger capacity, and improved fuel efficiency will help us serve more passengers, improve our product offering, and operate more efficiently,” says PAL Holdings president and chief operating officer Lucio C Tan III.
The airline originally announced a commitment for up to 20 787-10s at the Farnborough air show in July alongside an order for up to 14 Airbus A350-1000s.
Boeing has a backlog of 1,132 orders for the 787 across all variants, and has delivered 11 this year as of October.
The 787-10 will be a new type for the carrier, and the deal is its first direct order with Boeing since 2007 , when it ordered 777-300ERs.
The post Philippine firms order for 15 787-10s first appeared on FlightGlobal .
body_zh: 该交易是菲律宾近二十年来首次直接向波音公司订购。
菲律宾航空已敲定 15 架波音 787-10 的订单，坚定了其于 2026 年 7 月宣布的承诺。
新飞机将由GE航空航天GEnx-1B发动机提供动力，并计划在未来十年内交付。作为交易的一部分，该航空公司可以选择再购买五架飞机。
“波音 787-10 将在我们的机队现代化和扩张计划中发挥重要作用。其先进的技术、更大的载客量和更高的燃油效率将帮助我们为更多乘客提供服务、改善我们的产品供应并提高运营效率，”PAL Holdings 总裁兼首席运营官 Lucio C Tan III 表示。
该航空公司最初在 7 月份的范堡罗航展上宣布承诺订购最多 20 架 787-10 飞机，同时订购最多 14 架空客 A350-1000 飞机。
波音公司积压了 1,132 架 787 所有型号的订单，截至 10 月份，今年已交付 11 架。
787-10 将是该航空公司的新型机型，该交易是该公司自 2007 年订购 777-300ER 以来首次直接向波音订购。
菲律宾公司订购的 15 787-10 架飞机首次出现在 FlightGlobal 上。

title_en: EuroAtlantic to launch Lagos-London flights for Enugu Air and Omni-Blu Aviation
title_zh: 欧洲大西洋航空将为埃努古航空和 Omni-Blu Aviation 开通拉各斯-伦敦航班
summary: Wet-lease specialist will operate an A330-200 on the route through a three-way partnership with the two Nigerian carriers. Portuguese wet-lease and charter specialist EuroAtlantic Airways will begin operating flights between Lagos and London Gatwick on behalf
summary_zh: 湿租赁专家将通过与两家尼日利亚航空公司的三方合作，在这条航线上运营一架 A330-200。葡萄牙湿租和ch
body_en: Wet-lease specialist will operate an A330-200 on the route through a three-way partnership with the two Nigerian carriers.

Portuguese wet-lease and charter specialist EuroAtlantic Airways will begin operating flights between Lagos and London Gatwick on behalf of Nigerian carriers Enugu Air and Omni-Blu Aviation in December.

The arrangement uses Omni-Blu’s designated traffic rights under the Nigeria-UK bilateral air services agreement, with Enugu serving as its codeshare and marketing partner, and EuroAtlantic operating the route with its aircraft and crew.
EuroAtlantic will operate four flights a week on the route from 10 December using an Airbus A330-200.

State-owned Enugu Air was granted an air operator’s certificate by Nigeria’s civil aviation authority earlier this year. It operates domestic flights using a fleet of Embraer 170, 190 and 195 regional jets, and recently launched a cross-border service to Douala in Cameroon. The London Gatwick service will be its first long-haul route.
Omni-Blu is a privately owned charter operator based in Lagos.
According to EuroAtlantic, the carrier plans to begin scheduled domestic and regional flights in the first quarter of 2027 using E190LR jets.

Omni-Blu chief executive Akin Olateru describes the agreement with EuroAtlantic and Enugu as a “historic first”, noting that it acts as “a partnership between two Nigerian airlines under a bilateral air services-inspired codeshare arrangement to serve an international route”.
Enugu Air chief executive Tolu Ita adds: “Connecting Lagos and London is a major step for Enugu Air and for the travellers who have asked for more choice on this route.”

EuroAtlantic chief executive Pauls Calitis says the agreement “shows the strength of our Airbus long-haul operation and our ability to deliver a reliable, flexible widebody aircraft wet-lease solution for airlines that are ready to grow”.

The Portuguese operator recently added an ex-Malaysia Airlines A330-300 to its fleet , which it has leased from Jackson Square Aviation. EuroAtlantic already operates Warsaw-New York flights on behalf of Polish carrier LOT, as well as long-haul services for Brazil’s Azul to Lisbon and Madrid.
The post EuroAtlantic to launch Lagos-London flights for Enugu Air and Omni-Blu Aviation first appeared on FlightGlobal .
body_zh: 湿租赁专家将通过与两家尼日利亚航空公司的三方合作，在这条航线上运营一架 A330-200。
葡萄牙湿租赁和包机专业公司欧洲大西洋航空将于 12 月开始代表尼日利亚航空公司埃努古航空 (Enugu Air) 和 Omni-Blu Aviation 运营拉各斯和伦敦盖特威克机场之间的航班。
该安排使用 Omni-Blu 在尼日利亚-英国双边航空服务协议下的指定航权，埃努古作为其代码共享和营销合作伙伴，欧洲大西洋航空公司以其飞机和机组人员运营该航线。
自 12 月 10 日起，欧洲大西洋航空公司将使用空客 A330-200 在该航线上每周运营 4 个航班。
今年早些时候，国有的埃努古航空公司获得了尼日利亚民航局颁发的航空运营商证书。该公司使用巴西航空工业公司 170、190 和 195 支线飞机组成的机队运营国内航班，最近还推出了飞往喀麦隆杜阿拉的跨境服务。伦敦盖特威克机场服务将是其第一条长途航线。
Omni-Blu 是一家位于拉各斯的私营包机运营商。
据 EuroAtlantic 称，该航空公司计划于 2027 年第一季度开始使用 E190LR 喷气式飞机执飞国内和地区定期航班。
Omni-Blu 首席执行官 Akin Olateru 将与 EuroAtlantic 和 Enugu 的协议描述为“历史性的首例”，并指出该协议是“两家尼日利亚航空公司根据双边航空服务代码共享安排建立的合作伙伴关系，为国际航线提供服务”。
埃努古航空首席执行官 Tolu Ita 补充道：“连接拉各斯和伦敦对于埃努古航空以及那些要求在这条航线上有更多选择的旅客来说是重要的一步。”
EuroAtlantic首席执行官Pauls Calitis表示，该协议“显示了我们空客长途运营的实力以及我们为准备发展的航空公司提供可靠、灵活的宽体飞机湿租赁解决方案的能力”。
这家葡萄牙运营商最近在其机队中增加了一架前马来西亚航空 A330-300，该飞机是从 Jackson Square Aviation 租赁的。欧洲大西洋航空公司已经代表波兰航空公司 LOT 运营华沙至纽约的航班，以及巴西蓝色航空公司飞往里斯本和马德里的长途航班。
欧洲大西洋航空 (EuroAtlantic) 为埃努古航空 (Enugu Air) 和 Omni-Blu Aviation 推出拉各斯 - 伦敦航班的消息首次出现在 FlightGlobal 上。

title_en: T-38s will continue to train new USAF fighter pilots until 2038 amid slow roll-out of new T-7A trainer
title_zh: 随着新型 T-7A 教练机的缓慢推出，T-38 将继续训练美国空军新战斗机飞行员直到 2038 年

body_en: The three-star general in charge of US Air Force training says the service expects to get another decade of use from aged Northrop trainers.
The US Air Force expects to continue operating its aged Northrop T-38 Talon trainer jets for another decade, even as it approaches initial operational capability with the new Boeing T-7A Red Hawk.

Speaking during a Mitchell Institute for Aerospace Studies webinar on 16 November, the commander of Air Education and Training Command said the USAF is confident it can keep the T-38 flying for another 10 years, despite an average age of 59 years.

“It’s going to be flying until 2037 or 2038, doing pilot training missions, which sounds fantastically far away, and it is,” says Lieutenant General Clark Quinn. “ But we believe the aircraft will make it… If something breaks on it that we’re not expecting, we may have an issue, but [there are] no signs of that right now.”

At the moment, Quinn says the USAF fleet of 490 T-38s is sitting around a 50% mission capability rate, with the primary culprit being maintenance on the jet’s two out-of-production General Electric J85 engines.

“Those engines were the primary limiting factor about three or four years ago when I first got to 19th Air Force, and we had actually had to cut back on T-38 flying because of that,” Quinn notes, referring to the AETC subordinate unit that oversees flying training.
“ We are now back to the correct amount of flying,” Quinn adds.
The lengthy, decade-long transition between the T-38 and T-7A is being driven by long-running challenges in certifying the Red Hawk and expanding into rate production.

Quinn says AETC is still on track to hit a previous estimate of reaching initial operational capability (IOC) on the Red Hawk in August 2027, although he offers the caveat that two of the three IOC criteria do not fall within his purview.

“We believe we need to have 14 T-7s on the ramp. We need to have all of our initial cadre instructors not just trained but proficient and ready to teach. And we also need the flight envelope of the aircraft to be expanded to the point that we can do the mission of the T-7,” he says.

Only the training of instructor pilots falls within the control of AETC. The command graduated its first class of T-7A instructor pilots in June at Randolph AFB. These are separate from the experimental test pilots who have been evaluating the jet at Edwards AFB as part of its airworthiness assessment.

The throughput of new instructors is currently limited by the number of aircraft available. AETC currently has only three T-7As at its Texas home base, one of which is being used “almost [as] a dedicated maintenance trainer” for training new ground support technicians, according to Quinn.

When it comes to aircraft availability, Boeing has been slow to ramp up T-7A production and deliveries, hindered by engineering challenges with the escape system and onboard software. The T-7A programme only completed its final ejection seat sled test in October.

The air force approved Boeing to begin low-rate production on the Red Hawk in April, clearing the way to start work on AETC’s initial batch of 14 aircraft under Lot 1. Quinn has previously said he expects to start receiving new T-7As at a rate of roughly one aircraft per month, starting in early 2027.

However, full-rate production is not expected until 2029, owing to delays in developmental testing stemming from the engineering problems and a lack of spare parts that have impacted mission readiness rates of the small T-7A test fleet at Edwards.
Those issues are also impacting the envelope expansion phase of flight testing at Edwards, which is a precursor to the start of student training operations at Randolph.

Both factors could cause AETC to not have enough trained instructor pilots certified on the T-7A by August, even if the aircraft are delivered to Randolph and the jet is fully certified by the air force test centre.

“If you go, ‘ here’s your full flight envelope’, and you give it to me in August of 2027, that’s not going to work because I needed to have my instructors training on it for several months prior to that,” Quinn says.

Beyond the initial cadre, normal use of the Red Hawk in AETC’s four-month instructor pilot training course will not begin until the T-7 programme has reached IOC. That means there will be a lag between the IOC milestone and when the training command has a full roster of instructors qualified on the new trainer.
Current USAF plans call for a total fleet of 351 T-7As to be delivered by 2036. A 2037-2038 sundown date for the T-38 offers a few years of wiggle room to account for any further delays.
body_zh: 负责美国空军训练的三星级将军表示，预计年老的诺斯罗普训练师将再为该部队提供十年服务。
美国空军预计将继续使用其老旧的诺斯罗普 T-38 Talon 教练机十年，即使其新型波音 T-7A 红鹰已接近初始作战能力。
11 月 16 日，美国空军教育和训练司令部司令在米切尔航空航天研究所举办的网络研讨会上发表讲话时表示，尽管 T-38 的平均机龄为 59 岁，但美国空军有信心能够让 T-38 继续飞行 10 年。
“它会一直飞行到 2037 年或 2038 年，执行飞行员训练任务，这听起来非常遥远，但事实确实如此，”克拉克·奎因中将说道。 “但我们相信飞机能够成功……如果飞机出现我们没有预料到的故障，我们可能会遇到问题，但目前还没有任何迹象。”
Quinn 表示，目前美国空军的 490 架 T-38 机队的任务能力率约为 50%，主要原因是该飞机的两台停产通用电气 J85 发动机的维护。
“大约三四年前，当我第一次到第 19 空军时，这些发动机是主要的限制因素，因此我们实际上不得不减少 T-38 的飞行，”奎因指出，他指的是负责监督飞行训练的 AETC 下属单位。
“我们现在回到了正确的飞行量，”奎因补充道。
T-38 和 T-7A 之间长达十年的漫长过渡是由红鹰认证和扩大产能方面的长期挑战推动的。
Quinn 表示，AETC 仍有望达到之前的预期，即 2027 年 8 月红鹰号达到初始作战能力 (IOC)，不过他警告说，三个 IOC 标准中的两个不属于他的职权范围。
“我们相信我们需要有 14 架 T-7 停在坡道上。我们需要让所有最初的骨干教官不仅接受过培训，而且要熟练并准备好教学。我们还需要将飞机的飞行包线扩大到我们可以执行 T-7 的任务，”他说。
只有飞行员教官的培训属于 AETC 的管辖范围。该司令部于 6 月在伦道夫空军基地完成了第一批 T-7A 教员飞行员的毕业典礼。这些飞行员​​与在爱德华兹空军基地评估这架飞机作为其适航性评估的一部分的实验试飞员是分开的。
目前，新教练的数量受到可用飞机数量的限制。奎因表示，AETC 目前在其德克萨斯州基地只有三架 T-7A，其中一架“几乎被用作专门的维护教练机”来培训新的地面支持技术人员。
在飞机可用性方面，由于逃生系统和机载软件的工程挑战，波音公司在 T-7A 生产和交付方面进展缓慢。 T-7A项目直到10月份才完成最后的弹射座椅雪橇测试。
空军批准波音公司于 4 月份开始在红鹰上进行小批量生产，为 AETC 第 1 批首批 14 架飞机的生产扫清了道路。奎因此前曾表示，他预计从 2027 年初开始，以每月大约一架飞机的速度开始接收新的 T-7A。
然而，由于工程问题和备件缺乏影响了爱德华兹小型 T-7A 测试机队的任务准备率，导致开发测试延迟，预计要到 2029 年才能实现全速生产。
这些问题也影响了爱德华兹飞行测试的包线扩展阶段，这是伦道夫开始学生培训业务的先兆。
这两个因素都可能导致 AETC 在 8 月份之前没有足够的训练有素的教官飞行员获得 T-7A 认证，即使飞机已交付给伦道夫并且该飞机已获得空军测试中心的全面认证。
Quinn 说：“如果你说，‘这是你的完整飞行包线’，然后在 2027 年 8 月把它给我，那是行不通的，因为我需要在此之前让我的教练接受几个月的培训。”
除了最初的骨干人员之外，在 T-7 项目到达 IOC 之前，AETC 为期四个月的教官飞行员培训课程中不会开始正常使用红鹰。这意味着国际奥委会的里程碑和训练指挥部拥有新教练合格的完整教练名册之间将存在一段时间差。
美国空军目前的计划要求到 2036 年交付总共 351 架 T-7A。T-38 的交付日期为 2037 年至 2038 年，这为应对任何进一步的延误提供了几年的回旋余地。

title_en: First Boeing F-15EX fighter jets arrive for permanent duty at key US air base in Japan
title_zh: 首架波音 F-15EX 战斗机抵达日本主要美国空军基地永久执勤
summary: Two new F-15EX Eagle II fighters are paving the way for a modernised US Air Force fighter fleet in the Pacific. The US Air Force’s Kadena Air Base in Japan has received its first two permanently assigned Boeing F-15EX Eagle II fighters, as replacements for the
summary_zh: 两架新型 F-15EX Eagle II 战斗机正在为太平洋地区现代化的美国空军战斗机群铺平道路。美国空军嘉手纳空军基地
body_en: Two new F-15EX Eagle II fighters are paving the way for a modernised US Air Force fighter fleet in the Pacific.
The US Air Force’s Kadena Air Base in Japan has received its first two permanently assigned Boeing F-15EX Eagle II fighters, as replacements for the now-retired F-15C/D.
The two aircraft – assigned to the 67th Fighter Squadron – arrived at the base on 15 November, making Kadena the first overseas US Air Force base to receive F-15EX fighters.

The arrival of these combat-configured aircraft in Japan comes almost two and a half years after Portland Air Guard Base in Oregon received the first operational F-15EX in June 2024. F-15EX test aircraft have previously visited the base on Okinawa island.
Long-term, the air force plans to station 36 F-15EXs at Kadena, replacing the 48 F-15C/D fighters that began leaving the base in November 2022 after more than 40 years of service.
Since then, the Pentagon has relied on rotational deployments of other fighters, including Lockheed Martin F-22 Raptors and F-35 Lightning IIs, to maintain a fighter presence at Kadena.
The new arrivals are the first step towards restoring a permanent fighter fleet at the base.
The F-15EX brings a range of upgrades over its F-15C/D predecessors, including a modern radar, upgraded avionics and advanced electronic warfare systems.

Unlike fifth-generation fighters such as the F-35 and F-22, the F-15EX lacks serious stealth capabilities. However, it is designed to operate alongside these other fighter aircraft, offering greater weapons-carrying capacity and additional firepower.

A Pentagon report published in 2025 found the F-15EX to be “ operationally effective ” in offensive and defensive counter-air missions, including against simulated fifth-generation adversary aircraft.

The fighter has also taken part in exercises involving uncrewed aircraft. During the US-led Valiant Shield military exercises in June 2026, an F-15EX flew alongside Boeing’s MQ-28 Ghost Bat, highlighting how the two types could operate together in the future.

Although not currently in use, the F-15EX also has the onboard capacity for a back-seat cockpit station, which could be used by a weapon systems officer or as a control station for the air force’s new General Atomics FQ-42 and Anduril Industries FQ-44 collaborative combat aircraft.

The older F-15Cs previously at Kadena only had a single seat and were used exclusively for air interdiction and air superiority, whereas the subsequent F-15E Strike Eagle added a backseat for supporting air-to-ground missions.
Two-seat F-15D trainers were used for instructor checkrides, requalification, upgrade training and orientation flights, although they were also combat capable.

“The arrival of the F-15EX at Kadena marks a significant milestone for American airpower in the Pacific,” says Brigadier General John Gallemore, commander of the US Air Force’s 18th Wing unit at Kadena.
“These aircraft strengthen our ability to deter aggression, respond to emerging threats and defend Japan alongside our allies and partners.”
Ahead of the aircraft’s arrival, pilots from the 67th Fighter Squadron completed F-15EX qualification training in the United States.
With the first two aircraft now at the base, the squadron is turning its attention towards integration.

“Getting the F-15EX to Kadena is just the beginning,” says Lieutenant Colonel Ajay Dua, commander of the 67th Fighter Squadron. “Now our focus shifts to integrating the aircraft into our flying operations, building experience as a squadron and learning how to get the most out of its capabilities.”
The air force has not yet disclosed when the F-15EXs will begin conducting operational missions from Kadena.
body_zh: 两架新型 F-15EX Eagle II 战斗机正在为太平洋地区现代化的美国空军战斗机群铺平道路。
美国空军位于日本的嘉手纳空军基地已接收首批两架永久分配的波音 F-15EX Eagle II 战斗机，作为现已退役的 F-15C/D 的替代品。
这两架飞机隶属于第 67 战斗机中队，于 11 月 15 日抵达该基地，使嘉手纳基地成为第一个接收 F-15EX 战斗机的美国海外空军基地。
这些战斗配置的飞机抵达日本大约是在俄勒冈州波特兰空军警卫基地于 2024 年 6 月接收第一架投入使用的 F-15EX 近两年半之后。F-15EX 测试机此前曾访问过冲绳岛的基地。
从长远来看，空军计划在嘉手纳驻扎 36 架 F-15EX，取代服役 40 多年后于 2022 年 11 月开始离开该基地的 48 架 F-15C/D 战斗机。
从那时起，五角大楼就依靠轮换部署其他战斗机，包括洛克希德·马丁公司的 F-22 猛禽战斗机和 F-35 闪电 II 战斗机，来维持嘉手纳机场的战斗机存在。
新抵达的人员是恢复基地永久战斗机机队的第一步。
F-15EX 比其 F-15C/D 前身进行了一系列升级，包括现代雷达、升级的航空电子设备和先进的电子战系统。
与F-35和F-22等第五代战斗机不同，F-15EX严重缺乏隐身能力。然而，它的设计初衷是与其他战斗机一起作战，提供更大的武器携带能力和额外的火力。
五角大楼 2025 年发布的一份报告发现，F-15EX 在进攻性和防御性防空任务中“作战有效”，包括针对模拟的第五代敌方飞机。
该战斗机还参加了无人驾驶飞机的演习。在 2026 年 6 月美国主导的“勇敢之盾”军事演习中，一架 F-15EX 与波音公司的 MQ-28 Ghost Bat 并肩飞行，凸显了这两种类型未来如何协同作战。
尽管目前尚未使用，F-15EX 还具有后座驾驶舱站的机载能力，可供武器系统官员使用，或作为空军新型通用原子公司 FQ-42 和 Anduril Industries FQ-44 协作战斗机的控制站。
之前在嘉手纳的老式 F-15C 只有一个座位，专门用于空中拦截和空中优势，而随后的 F-15E 攻击鹰增加了一个后座，用于支持空对地任务。
两座 F-15D 教练机用于教员检查、重新资格认证、升级训练和定向飞行，尽管它们也具有战斗能力。
“F-15EX 抵达嘉手纳标志着美国太平洋空中力量的一个重要里程碑，”驻嘉手纳的美国空军第 18 联队指挥官约翰·加勒莫尔准将表示。
“这些飞机增强了我们遏制侵略、应对新威胁以及与我们的盟友和伙伴一道保卫日本的能力。”
在飞机抵达之前，第 67 战斗机中队的飞行员在美国完成了 F-15EX 资格培训。
随着前两架飞机现已抵达基地，该中队正在将注意力转向整合。
“将 F-15EX 送往嘉手纳仅仅是一个开始，”第 67 战斗机中队指挥官阿贾伊·杜阿 (Ajay Dua) 中校说道。 “现在我们的重点转向将飞机整合到我们的飞行行动中，积累作为中队的经验并学习如何充分利用其能力。”
空军尚未透露 F-15EX 何时开始从嘉手纳机场执行作战任务。

title_en: DLR, Embraer test low-sulphur fuel in bid to curb contrails
title_zh: 德国航天中心 (DLR) 与巴西航空工业公司 (Embraer) 测试低硫燃料以遏制凝结尾迹
summary: The team is seeking to better understand how fuel sulphur levels affect contrail formation. Embraer and Germany’s DLR aerospace research centre have completed a flight-test programme intended to determine the degree to which low-sulphur jet fuel can prevent fo
summary_zh: 该团队正在寻求更好地了解燃料硫含量如何影响凝结尾迹的形成。巴西航空工业公司与德国 DLR 航空航天研究中心合作
body_en: The team is seeking to better understand how fuel sulphur levels affect contrail formation.

Embraer and Germany’s DLR aerospace research centre have completed a flight-test programme intended to determine the degree to which low-sulphur jet fuel can prevent formation of aircraft contrails, which are viewed as environmentally harmful.
The Brazilian manufacturer flew an E195-E2 under the programme, called the International Ground and Inflight Turbine Emission Experiment (IGNITE-X).

The tests started in October, lasted four weeks and involved the jet’s Pratt & Whitney PW1900G geared turbofans burning both conventional jet fuel and fuel modified to have a “particularly low sulphur content”, the DLR said on 16 November. The flights were operated over the German states of Bavaria and Saxony.

“Contrails contribute significantly to aviation’s climate impact. One key to reducing this impact lies in optimising aircraft fuels and engines,” the institute says. “The researchers aim to determine whether combining an engine with low-soot-emissions and low-sulphur fuel can significantly reduce contrail formation.”
Contrails are ice crystals that form around particles of soot and sulphur contained within aircraft engine emissions. Contrails are thought to have a warming effect on the atmosphere.

During the test flights, the DLR flew its own aircraft, a Dassault Falcon 20E, behind the E195-E2, at distances as close as 30m (98ft) and as far as 16nm (30km), for the purpose of measuring the E-Jet’s emissions and contrails.

“Particular attention was paid to the smallest particles in the nanometre range. Investigating their number, size distribution and properties provides insights into early particle formation and the initial transformation processes in the exhaust plume,” the DLR adds.
The programme’s ground tests involved measuring emissions from the PW1900Gs at various thrust settings.

“We are working alongside leading research institutions and industry partners to better understand the relationship between fuel characteristics, engine performance and contrail formation,” says Embraer vice-president of technology and advanced projects Cleiton Silva.
It is unclear when the DLR expects to publish its findings. The research organisation did not immediately respond to a request for more information.
The post DLR, Embraer test low-sulphur fuel in bid to curb contrails first appeared on FlightGlobal .
body_zh: 该团队正在寻求更好地了解燃料硫含量如何影响凝结尾迹的形成。
巴西航空工业公司和德国航天中心航空研究中心完成了一项飞行测试计划，旨在确定低硫喷气燃料在多大程度上可以防止形成飞机尾迹，而尾迹被认为对环境有害。
这家巴西制造商在名为“国际地面和飞行中涡轮机排放实验”(IGNITE-X) 的计划下试飞了一架 E195-E2。
德国航天中心 11 月 16 日表示，测试于 10 月开始，持续了四个星期，涉及飞机的普惠 PW1900G 齿轮传动涡轮风扇发动机，燃烧传统喷气燃料和经过改造的“硫含量特别低”的燃料。这些航班在德国巴伐利亚州和萨克森州上空飞行。
“凝结尾迹对航空业的气候影响有重大影响。减少这种影响的关键在于优化飞机燃料和发动机，”该研究所表示。 “研究人员的目标是确定将低烟灰排放发动机与低硫燃料相结合是否可以显着减少凝结尾迹的形成。”
凝结尾迹是在飞机发动机排放物中所含的烟灰和硫颗粒周围形成的冰晶。凝结尾迹被认为对大气有变暖作用。
在测试飞行期间，德国航天中心在 E195-E2 后面驾驶了自己的飞机 Dassault Falcon 20E，飞行距离近至 30m（98 英尺），远至 16 海里（30 公里），目的是测量 E-Jet 的排放和尾迹。
“我们特别关注纳米范围内的最小颗粒。研究它们的数量、尺寸分布和特性可以深入了解早期颗粒形成和废气羽流中的初始转化过程，”德国航天中心补充道。
该计划的地面测试涉及测量 PW1900G 在各种推力设置下的发射。
“我们正在与领先的研究机构和行业合作伙伴合作，以更好地了解燃料特性、发动机性能和凝结尾迹形成之间的关系，”巴西航空工业公司技术和先进项目副总裁克莱顿·席尔瓦（Cleiton Silva）表示。
目前尚不清楚德国航天中心预计何时公布其调查结果。该研究组织没有立即回应提供更多信息的请求。
德国航空航天局 (DLR) 后，巴西航空工业公司 (Embraer) 测试低硫燃油以遏制凝结尾迹，该消息首次出现在 FlightGlobal 上。

title_en: Bell completes assembly of first MV-75 fuselage
title_zh: 贝尔完成首架 MV-75 机身组装
summary: Bell took over MV-75 fuselage fabrication from Sprirt AeroSystems when the aerostructures company was acquired by Boeing. Rotorcraft manufacturer Bell has completed assembly on the first fuselage section for the company’s new MV-75 Cheyenne II military tiltrot
summary_zh: 当 Sprit AeroSystems 航空结构公司被波音收购后，贝尔接手了该公司的 MV-75 机身制造工作。旋翼机制造商贝尔
body_en: Bell took over MV-75 fuselage fabrication from Sprirt AeroSystems when the aerostructures company was acquired by Boeing.
Rotorcraft manufacturer Bell has completed assembly on the first fuselage section for the company’s new MV-75 Cheyenne II military tiltrotor.

Bell confirmed the milestone on 16 November, shortly after it completed the first MV-75 wing assembly and engine nacelles in October. Final assembly of the new tiltrotor will take place in Amarillo, Texas, where Bell already builds the V-22 Osprey, but fuselages for the Cheyenne II are built in Wichita, Kansas.

Adam Blackford, general manager of Bell’s Wichita Assembly Center, says the company “rapidly established infrastructure… to design and assemble the first fuselage”, only two years after Wichita was identified as the site of MV-75 fuselage production.
“The completion of this fuselage reflects our unwavering commitment to delivering the MV-75 Cheyenne to our warfighters,” Blackford says.
Each MV-75 fuselage includes forward, mid and aft structural sections. Bell says those three portions have been mated and joined, with the outer skin applied.

The lead Cheyenne fuselage has already been delivered to Amarillo, where it will be mated with the wing structure and nacelles. That full aircraft assembly will then undergo structural stress testing, which Bell says will be the first major test of the MV-75’s capability, reliability and safety.

Aerostructures manufacturer Spirit AeroSystems provided the main fuselage assembly for Bell’s V-280 Valor competitive prototype that won the US Army’s Future Long-Range Assault Aircraft competition. However, Bell dropped Spirit as a supplier in 2024 when Boeing moved to acquire Spirit, which is a key supplier of fuselages to Boeing’s commercial aircraft enterprise.
Rather than find another subcontractor, Bell chose to vertically integrate and bring that work in-house.
“Our top priority is delivering this next-generation capability to the army with urgency, without sacrificing on quality or safety,” Bell says.

Bell’s parent company, Textron, has a significant aircraft manufacturing footprint in Wichita, including the Beechcraft King Air 360, Cessna Citation business jets and the Beechcraft T-6 Texan II military trainer. Textron has also said it would build the M-346N jet trainer in Wichita, if selected by the US Navy as the Boeing T-45 Goshawk replacement.
The US Army has contracted with Bell to provide six MV-75 test aircraft while planning to equip its first combat unit with 24 Cheyenne II tiltrotors by fiscal year 2030.
The post Bell completes assembly of first MV-75 fuselage first appeared on FlightGlobal .
body_zh: 当 Sprit AeroSystems 航空结构公司被波音收购后，贝尔接手了该公司的 MV-75 机身制造工作。
旋翼机制造商贝尔公司已完成该公司新型 MV-75 Cheyenne II 军用倾转旋翼机第一机身部分的组装。
贝尔于 10 月完成首个 MV-75 机翼组装和发动机短舱后不久，于 11 月 16 日确认了这一里程碑。新型倾转旋翼机的最终组装将在德克萨斯州阿马里洛进行，贝尔已经在那里制造了 V-22 鱼鹰，但夏延 II 的机身是在堪萨斯州威奇托制造的。
贝尔威奇托组装中心总经理 Adam Blackford 表示，距离威奇托被确定为 MV-75 机身生产地仅两年后，该公司“迅速建立了基础设施……以设计和组装第一架机身”。
“该机身的完成反映了我们坚定不移地致力于为我们的战士提供 MV-75 Cheyenne，”Blackford 说。
每个 MV-75 机身均包括前部、中部和后部结构部分。贝尔说，这三个部分已经配对并连接在一起，并贴上了外皮。
夏安的主要机身已经交付到阿马里洛，在那里它将与机翼结构和发动机舱相匹配。然后，整个飞机组装件将接受结构应力测试，贝尔表示这将是对 MV-75 性能、可靠性和安全性的首次重大测试。
航空结构制造商 Spirit AeroSystems 为贝尔的 V-280 Valor 竞争原型机提供了主要机身组件，该原型机赢得了美国陆军未来远程攻击机竞赛。然而，当波音公司于 2024 年收购 Spirit 时，贝尔放弃了 Spirit 作为供应商，后者是波音商用飞机企业机身的主要供应商。
贝尔没有寻找另一个分包商，而是选择垂直整合并将这项工作转移到内部。
贝尔说：“我们的首要任务是在不牺牲质量或安全的情况下，紧急向军队提供这种下一代能力。”
贝尔的母公司德事隆 (Textron) 在威奇托拥有重要的飞机制造基地，包括比奇空中国王 360、塞斯纳奖状商务喷气机和比奇 T-6 Texan II 军用教练机。德事隆还表示，如果美国海军选择其作为波音 T-45 苍鹰的替代机，它将在威奇托建造 M-346N 喷气教练机。
美国陆军已与贝尔公司签订合同，提供 6 架 MV-75 测试飞机，同时计划到 2030 财年为其第一个作战部队配备 24 架夏安 II 倾转旋翼机。
贝尔完成第一架 MV-75 机身组装的帖子首次出现在 FlightGlobal 上。

title_en: Flyyo pulls out of plan to operate flights for Fly2Galicia, alleging non-payment
title_zh: Flyyo 因未付款而退出为 Fly2Galicia 运营航班的计划
summary: Romanian charter carrier had planned to start flying from Santiago to eight European cities for the Spanish start-up in early December. Romanian charter and ACMI specialist Flyyo will no longer operate planned flights from Santiago in northwest Spain to eight
summary_zh: 罗马尼亚包机航空公司原计划于 12 月初为这家西班牙初创公司开始从圣地亚哥飞往八个欧洲城市的航班。罗马尼亚图表
body_en: Romanian charter carrier had planned to start flying from Santiago to eight European cities for the Spanish start-up in early December.

Romanian charter and ACMI specialist Flyyo will no longer operate planned flights from Santiago in northwest Spain to eight European destinations on behalf of Fly2Galicia, citing an alleged failure by the Spanish start-up to fulfil payment obligations under their agreement.

Flyyo had confirmed to FlightGlobal in August that it would operate Airbus A320 flights for Fly2Galicia from Santiago to Alicante, Brussels, Granada, Milan, Munich, Prague, Venice and Zaragoza. The flights were scheduled to begin in early December.

However, in a 16 November LinkedIn post, Flyyo says that it “will not operate any of the flights to and from Santiago de Compostela sold by Fly2Galicia”, adding: “Flyyo was to operate these flights for Fly2Galicia under a charter agreement.

“Fly2Galicia did not make the payments due under that agreement, and Flyyo has terminated it. Under the agreement, Fly2Galicia must indemnify Flyyo against all passenger claims relating to these flights.”

Flyyo advises passengers who have bought tickets for the flights to contact Fly2Galicia – which, it says, “sold the tickets and received the passengers’ payments” – to request a refund. The flights were being marketed by Santiago-based Aviation & Mobility Services Group under the Fly2Galicia brand, but Flyyo was going to operate them on a charter basis.
Fly2Galicia’s website still markets the flights as being for sale.
FlightGlobal has contacted Fly2Galicia for comment.
The post Flyyo pulls out of plan to operate flights for Fly2Galicia, alleging non-payment first appeared on FlightGlobal .
body_zh: 罗马尼亚包机航空公司原计划于 12 月初为这家西班牙初创公司开始从圣地亚哥飞往八个欧洲城市的航班。
罗马尼亚包机和 ACMI 专业公司 Flyyo 将不再代表 Fly2Galicia 运营从西班牙西北部圣地亚哥飞往八个欧洲目的地的计划航班，理由是这家西班牙初创公司未能履行协议规定的付款义务。
Flyyo于8月份向FlightGlobal确认，它将为Fly2Galicia运营从圣地亚哥飞往阿利坎特、布鲁塞尔、格拉纳达、米兰、慕尼黑、布拉格、威尼斯和萨拉戈萨的空客A320航班。这些航班原定于十二月初开始。
然而，Flyyo 在 11 月 16 日的 LinkedIn 帖子中表示，它“不会运营 Fly2Galicia 出售的任何往返圣地亚哥德孔波斯特拉的航班”，并补充道：“Flyyo 将根据包机协议为 Fly2Galicia 运营这些航班。
“Fly2Galicia 没有支付该协议项下的到期付款，Flyyo 已终止该协议。根据该协议，Fly2Galicia 必须赔偿 Flyyo 与这些航班相关的所有乘客索赔。”
Flyyo 建议已购买航班机票的乘客联系 Fly2Galicia（该公司称其“已售出机票并收到乘客的付款”）要求退款。这些航班由总部位于圣地亚哥的航空与移动服务集团以 Fly2Galicia 品牌进行营销，但 Flyyo 将以包机的方式运营这些航班。
Fly2Galicia 的网站仍然将这些航班标为待售。
FlightGlobal 已联系 Fly2Galicia 征求意见。
这篇文章称，Flyyo 取消了 Fly2Galicia 的航班运营计划，并指控未付款行为首先出现在 FlightGlobal 上。

title_en: United chief calls ATC meltdown ‘call to action’
title_zh: 曼联主席称空中交通管制崩溃“呼吁采取行动”
summary: Cancellation data from the weekend show JetBlue Airways and American Airlines most affected by lingering effects of ground stop. United chief executive Scott Kirby says the communications issue that resulted in an hours-long ground stop and more than 15,000 fl
summary_zh: 周末的航班取消数据显示，捷蓝航空和美国航空受地面停靠的持续影响影响最大。联合首席执行官
body_en: Cancellation data from the weekend show JetBlue Airways and American Airlines most affected by lingering effects of ground stop.

United chief executive Scott Kirby says the communications issue that resulted in an hours-long ground stop and more than 15,000 flight cancellations over the weekend should serve as a “call to action”.

In a 15 November statement, Kirby praised the US Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) for its “decisive action to keep our airspace safe and secure” as air traffic controllers worked to land planes after communications and radar feeds went down.
He also calls for a bipartisan effort, saying the system needs “more investment in modern technology to ensure better redundancy and reliability now”.

“This moment must be a call to action,” he continues. “It is critical for safety, our passengers and our economy that we fix our nation’s air traffic control system now. The FAA has incredible people who work hard, keep the skies safe and take pride in what they do.”

Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy strikes a similar tone, urging Congress to approve more funds for airspace modernisation. Duffy now says the project will cost $50 billion, up from a prior $30 billion estimate. Those figures include $12.5 billion Congress approved for air traffic control upgrades last year.

The FAA blames the cascading issues on a radar site near Amarillo, Texas and a radio site in Arkansas where supplier L3Harris has been doing work. The instability eventually spread to 17 of 22 air route traffic control centres as well as terminal radar approach control facilities, leading to the nationwide ground stop on 13 November.

L3Harris says it has completed more than 70% of upgrades in the system from copper wires to modern fibre optics. “We are supporting the FAA in its investigation to understand the conditions that led to the… ground stop of our nation’s air travel,” the company said on Saturday, 14 November.
Safety was never compromised, the FAA says, ruling out any indications of cyberattack .

The FAA lifted the ground stop later on 13 November, after 4h. US airlines cancelled about 35% of flights on Friday and nearly 30% on Saturday, totalling more than 15,000 flights scrubbed, according to Cirium data.
Things began to return to normal on 15 November, with just 7% of scheduled flights not completed as of 16:00 US eastern time. A roughly 3% cancellation rate is considered standard.
Delays are likely to persist into Monday but the cancellation rate had dropped significantly.
Some airlines were more affected than others by rolling cancellations and resulting crew-scheduling issues.

JetBlue Airways saw the biggest impact from cancellations, with 33% of flights cancelled between 13 and 16 November. American Airlines cancelled 23% of its flights in the three-day period, Cirium says. Both airlines, along with much of the industry, had fee waivers in place for reservation changes.

“With crews and aircraft in position and favourable weather expected across our system, we are set up for a good start to the week and do not anticipate additional broad cancellations related to this incredibly disruptive industry-wide event,” American said late on 15 November.
The post United chief calls ATC meltdown ‘call to action’ first appeared on FlightGlobal .
body_zh: 周末的航班取消数据显示，捷蓝航空和美国航空受地面停靠的持续影响影响最大。
美联航首席执行官斯科特·柯比 (Scott Kirby) 表示，通信问题导致了长达数小时的地面停留以及周末超过 15,000 架航班取消，这应该成为“采取行动的号召”。
在 11 月 15 日的一份声明中，柯比赞扬美国联邦航空管理局 (FAA) 在通信和雷达信号中断后空中交通管制员努力让飞机着陆时“为确保我们的空域安全而采取的果断行动”。
他还呼吁两党共同努力，称该系统需要“对现代技术进行更多投资，以确保现在更好的冗余和可靠性”。
“这一刻必须呼吁采取行动，”他继续说道。 “现在修复我们国家的空中交通管制系统对于安全、乘客和经济都至关重要。美国联邦航空局拥有令人难以置信的员工，他们努力工作，维护天空安全，并为自己的工作感到自豪。”
交通部长肖恩·达菲也表达了类似的态度，敦促国会批准更多资金用于空域现代化。达菲现在表示，该项目将耗资 500 亿美元，高于之前预计的 300 亿美元。这些数字包括国会去年批准用于空中交通管制升级的 125 亿美元。
美国联邦航空局将一系列问题归咎于德克萨斯州阿马里洛附近的一个雷达站点和供应商 L3Harris 一直在阿肯色州工作的一个无线电站点。不稳定局势最终蔓延到 22 个航路交通管制中心中的 17 个以及航站楼雷达进场控制设施，导致 11 月 13 日全国范围内停飞。
L3Harris 表示，它已经完成了系统 70% 以上的升级，从铜线到现代光纤。该公司于 11 月 14 日星期六表示：“我们正在支持美国联邦航空管理局 (FAA) 的调查，以了解导致……我国航空旅行地面停止的原因。”
美国联邦航空局表示，安全从未受到损害，并排除了任何网络攻击的迹象。
11 月 13 日晚些时候，4 小时后，美国联邦航空局解除了地面停留。 Cirium 的数据显示，美国航空公司周五取消了约 35% 的航班，周六取消了近 30% 的航班，总共取消了 15,000 多个航班。
11 月 15 日，情况开始恢复正常，截至美国东部时间 16:00，仅有 7% 的定期航班未完成。大约 3% 的取消率被认为是标准的。
延误可能会持续到周一，但取消率已大幅下降。
一些航空公司比其他航空公司受到滚动取消和由此产生的机组人员调度问题的影响更大。
捷蓝航空受到取消影响最大，11 月 13 日至 16 日期间取消了 33% 的航班。 Cirium 表示，美国航空在三天内取消了 23% 的航班。两家航空公司以及该行业的许多公司都对预订变更实行了费用减免。
美国航空 11 月 15 日晚间表示：“机组人员和飞机已就位，而且整个系统预计天气良好，我们已为本周的良好开局做好了准备，预计不会出现与这一极具破坏性的全行业活动相关的更多航班取消。”
这位美联航负责人称 ATC 崩溃是“号召性用语”，首次出现在 FlightGlobal 上。

title_en: How Middle East conflicts impacted our latest World Air Forces review
title_zh: 中东冲突如何影响我们最新的世界空军评论
summary: Major conflict in the Middle East resulted in high-profile aircraft losses for Iran, the US and several regional allies. Our annual review of the global military fleet details the key developments. Our annual World Air Forces directory – published in associati
summary_zh: 中东的重大冲突导致伊朗、美国和几个地区盟友遭受了引人注目的飞机损失。我们对全球的年度回顾
body_en: Major conflict in the Middle East resulted in high-profile aircraft losses for Iran, the US and several regional allies. Our annual review of the global military fleet details the key developments.

Our annual World Air Forces directory – published in association with Embraer and data partner Cirium – details the military aircraft fleets of 160 nations, and analyses the main events of the last 12 months. Click here to read and download the full report , which includes detailed fleet listings totalling 52,160 in-service aircraft.
US-led military activities dominated in 2026, with notable campaigns affecting nations in Latin America and the Middle East.
The year had barely begun when US special forces conducted an audacious raid during the early hours of 3 January to capture and extract Venezuelan President Nicolas Maduro.

Dubbed Operation Absolute Resolve, that action involved Boeing MH-47G and Sikorsky MH-60M helicopters, supported by a large package of combat aircraft which struck targets including air defence infrastructure.

That smash and grab incursion was soon followed by a much more substantial conflict, as the US and Israel on 28 February launched major strikes on Iran. Washington labelled its war Operation Epic Fury, and during its opening hours Iran’s spiritual leader Ayatollah Ali Khamenei was killed amid large-scale attacks on Tehran.

The Islamic Republic did not collapse as anticipated, however, instead launching retaliatory attacks against US forces and Washington’s military allies in the Middle East. That included a high-profile strike mounted against Saudi Arabia’s Prince Sultan air base, which destroyed a number of US support aircraft, including one of the US Air Force’s (USAF’s) Boeing E-3 Sentry airborne early warning and control jets.

Other notable moments included a Kuwait air force Boeing F-18 pilot shooting down three USAF Boeing F-15Es in a ‘friendly fire’ incident, and a massive combat search and rescue (CSAR) mission mounted to save the crew of another F-15E which had been downed inside Iranian territory.

While both crew members were ultimately extracted alive, several US aircraft – among them two Lockheed Martin MC-130Js and four Boeing MH-6 Little Bird light attack helicopters – had to be destroyed after the transports became stuck in soft ground during the rescue mission.

The pilot of a Fairchild Republic A-10 also was recovered after their jet was downed during the CSAR effort. The US also had seen at least 45 uncrewed General Atomics Aeronautical Systems MQ-9 Reapers destroyed by late-September, and in all, at least 81 of its aircraft had been lost or damaged, also including seven Boeing KC-135 tankers.

While the US and Israel claim to have “obliterated” their foe’s military aviation assets, the exact detail of Tehran’s losses cannot be verified, meaning our fleet listing for its forces may not fully reflect conditions on the ground.

Less ambiguity exists in Yemen, however, with the Middle East nation’s entire inventory having been taken out during offensive action mounted by Houthi rebels. That has seen 160 previously operational aircraft removed from our global fleet listing: 68 combat aircraft; three transports; 59 combat helicopters; and 30 training aircraft/helicopters.
In another significant development, a Royal Saudi Air Force F-15SA was shot down by the Houthis in mid-September using a surface-to-air missile, marking their first such successful engagement.
The removal of Yemen’s military aircraft fleet follows a similar upheaval inside Syria, which disappeared from our rankings in last year’s report, marking the loss of its 414 aircraft.

Meanwhile, Ukraine has maintained its defence against Russian invasion, with Kyiv continuing to repel Moscow’s aggression which started in February 2022. While day-to-day operations are dominated by the use of one-way attack and first-person view drones, plus cruise missiles, air power continues to play a key role on both sides.

Our full listings show that Ukraine has 359 aircraft in active use – a year-on-year rise of 12 – while Russia has 4,186 (down 51). Their mismatch in equipment numbers is particularly stark in the combat aircraft category, where Kyiv can draw on 128 strike aircraft, versus Moscow’s 1,509.
However, the Ukrainian air force is receiving more donated Lockheed F-16s, while the nation advances on planned purchases of both Dassault Aviation Rafales and Saab Gripens.

Prepared using information from data partner and aviation analytics company Cirium, our 2027 directory lists a total of 52,160 aircraft in active use with 160 nations. That represents a net reduction of 71 since our previous report, but that topline figure masks some significant changes recorded during our review period.
Our combat aircraft total of 14,517 is an increase of 443 year-on-year, largely due to updated reporting of China’s inventory.

That gain was balanced overall by significant reductions in two other categories: the combat helicopter figure declined by 202, to 19,947; and training aircraft/helicopters dipped by 218 aircraft, to 10,857.
body_zh: 中东的重大冲突导致伊朗、美国和几个地区盟友遭受了引人注目的飞机损失。我们对全球军事舰队的年度回顾详细介绍了主要发展情况。
我们与巴西航空工业公司和数据合作伙伴 Cirium 联合发布的年度世界空军名录详细介绍了 160 个国家的军用飞机机队，并分析了过去 12 个月的主要事件。单击此处阅读并下载完整报告，其中包括总计 52,160 架在役飞机的详细机队列表。
2026 年，美国领导的军事活动占主导地位，其中一些引人注目的活动影响了拉丁美洲和中东国家。
新年伊始，美国特种部队就在 1 月 3 日凌晨进行了一次大胆的突袭，抓获并解救了委内瑞拉总统尼古拉斯·马杜罗。
这次行动被称为“绝对决心”行动，出动了波音 MH-47G 和西科斯基 MH-60M 直升机，并得到大批战斗机的支持，袭击了包括防空基础设施在内的目标。
随着美国和以色列于 2 月 28 日对伊朗发动大规模袭击，这次粉碎和掠夺入侵很快就发生了一场更为严重的冲突。华盛顿将其战争称为“史诗般的愤怒”行动，在行动开始期间，伊朗精神领袖阿亚图拉·阿里·哈梅内伊在德黑兰的大规模袭击中被杀。
然而，伊斯兰共和国并没有像预期那样崩溃，而是对美军和华盛顿在中东的军事盟友发动报复性袭击。其中包括对沙特阿拉伯苏丹王子空军基地进行的一次高调打击，摧毁了多架美国支援飞机，其中包括美国空军 (USAF) 的一架波音 E-3 Sentry 机载预警和控制飞机。
其他值得注意的时刻包括一名科威特空军波音 F-18 飞行员在一次“友军误伤”事件中击落了三架美国空军波音 F-15E，以及为拯救另一架在伊朗境内被击落的 F-15E 机组人员而开展的大规模战斗搜救 (CSAR) 任务。
虽然两名机组人员最终被生还，但几架美国飞机——其中包括两架洛克希德·马丁公司的 MC-130J 和四架波音 MH-6 小鸟轻型攻击直升机——在救援任务中因运输机陷入松软的地面而不得不被摧毁。
Fairchild Republic A-10 的飞行员在 CSAR 行动中被击落后也被救出。截至 9 月底，美国还发现至少 45 架无人通用原子航空系统 MQ-9 收割机被摧毁，总共至少有 81 架飞机丢失或损坏，其中还包括 7 架波音 KC-135 加油机。
虽然美国和以色列声称已经“消灭”了敌人的军事航空资产，但德黑兰损失的具体细节无法得到证实，这意味着我们列出的其部队的机队名单可能无法完全反映当地的情况。
然而，也门的情况就不那么模糊了，这个中东国家的全部库存都在胡塞叛军发起的进攻行动中被清空。这使得 160 架之前投入使用的飞机从我们的全球机队名单中删除：68 架战斗机；三种运输方式； 59架战斗直升机；和30架教练机/直升机。
另一项重大进展是，9 月中旬，沙特皇家空军的一架 F-15SA 被胡塞武装使用地对空导弹击落，这是他们首次成功交战。
也门军用飞机机队撤离之前，叙利亚境内也发生了类似的动荡，叙利亚从我们去年报告的排名中消失，损失了 414 架飞机。
与此同时，乌克兰保持了对俄罗斯入侵的防御，基辅继续击退莫斯科自 2022 年 2 月开始的侵略。虽然日常行动主要使用单向攻击和第一人称视角无人机以及巡航导弹，但空中力量继续在双方发挥着关键作用。
我们的完整列表显示，乌克兰有 359 架在用飞机，同比增加 12 架，而俄罗斯有 4,186 架（减少 51 架）。他们在装备数量上的不匹配在战斗机类别中尤为明显，基辅可以动用 128 架攻击机，而莫斯科则有 1,509 架。
然而，乌克兰空军正在接收更多捐赠的洛克希德 F-16 战斗机，同时该国也推进了达索航空阵风战斗机和萨博鹰狮战斗机的采购计划。
我们的 2027 年目录使用数据合作伙伴和航空分析公司 Cirium 提供的信息编制，列出了 160 个国家/地区正在使用的总共 52,160 架飞机。这意味着自我们上次报告以来净减少了 71 人，但这一顶线数字掩盖了我们审查期间记录的一些重大变化。
我们的战斗机总数为 14,517 架，同比增加 443 架，这主要是由于中国库存报告的更新。
这一增长总体上被其他两个类别的大幅减少所抵消：战斗直升机数量减少了 202 架，降至 19,947 架；训练飞机/直升机减少 218 架，至 10,857 架。

title_en: Flight attendant union eyes organising push after Democratic midterm sweep
title_zh: 民主党中期大获全胜后，空乘工会着眼于组织推动
summary: Association of Flight Attendants president says unions are ‘more popular than they’ve been in 100 years’ as Delta drive gains ground. Emboldened by the Democrats’ midterm election wins across the USA in November, the country’s largest flight attendants union i
summary_zh: 空乘人员协会主席表示，随着达美航空的发展，工会“比一百年来更受欢迎”。受到了鼓舞
body_en: Association of Flight Attendants president says unions are ‘more popular than they’ve been in 100 years’ as Delta drive gains ground.
Emboldened by the Democrats’ midterm election wins across the USA in November, the country’s largest flight attendants union is plotting a massive organising drive.

Sara Nelson, president of the Association of Flight Attendants (AFA), hopes the wave can be enough to finally stand up a union at Delta Air Lines , long the union’s white whale and the only remaining US legacy carrier without a cabin crew union.

Speaking at the Skift Aviation Forum in New York on 12 November, Nelson said the union now has, on average, at least one flight attendant organiser on every Delta flight: “We’ve never seen it in that place before.”

Delta has declined to comment. In years past, the airline has maintained its “direct relationship” with workers is faster and more effective at improving pay and working conditions. In a 2010 vote, Delta flight attendants rejected unionisation.
“Unions are more popular than they’ve been in 100 years,” says Nelson. “It’s ripe for union organising, and I think we’re going to see big wins in the South.”

In recent years, flight attendants at most major US carriers have signed new contracts with significant pay increases. Many of those deals came “four, five, six years late because of Covid”, she adds.
Nelson says the round will likely bring steady gains, but not the huge jumps seen in the past – and that’s by design.

“If we can get to the table, have a fewer number of issues and negotiate those contracts more regularly, airline workers will see regular increases,” Nelson says. “You won’t have these huge jumps, and then you won’t have the problem of competitors being concerned about when their competitor is going to have to pay these huge increases.”
The union is also looking to an upcoming round of negotiations at regional carriers for big wins.

Regional flight attendants are now largely based at expensive hubs like Chicago and New York but make “essentially half of what the mainline flight attendants are making”, Nelson says. Most also lack boarding pay, which she says is worth roughly 16% of compensation at regional carriers, against about 8% at mainline airlines, due to their short average flight times.

AFA returns to the table with American Airlines subsidiary PSA Airlines on 13 November, and begins talks with Delta-owned Endeavor Air in December, where Nelson says Delta “has the cash to equalise that pay” for about 1,700 flight attendants.

Boarding pay is slowly becoming standard across the industry. In Canada, Air Canada cabin crew went on strike in August 2025 over unpaid ground work and secured boarding pay in February, and WestJet flight attendants walked out over the same issue this summer. In the US, Delta began paying for boarding in 2022, and contracts at American and Alaska now include it.

“Passengers were educated for the first time that flight attendants have not been paid during that time, and so the public was outraged,” says Nelson. “The public is on our side. So there’s no way they’re going to claw that back.”
The post Flight attendant union eyes organising push after Democratic midterm sweep first appeared on FlightGlobal .
body_zh: 空乘人员协会主席表示，随着达美航空的发展，工会“比一百年来更受欢迎”。
受民主党 11 月在美国中期选举胜利的鼓舞，美国最大的空乘人员工会正在策划一场大规模的组织活动。
空乘人员协会 (AFA) 主席萨拉·尼尔森 (Sara Nelson) 希望这一浪潮足以最终在达美航空 (Delta Air Lines) 建立工会。达美航空是该工会长期以来的白鲸，也是唯一一家没有空乘工会的美国传统航空公司。
11 月 12 日，尼尔森在纽约 Skift 航空论坛上发表讲话时表示，工会现在平均每架达美航班上至少有一名空乘组织者：“我们以前从未在那个地方见过这种情况。”
达美航空拒绝置评。在过去的几年里，该航空公司一直与工人保持着“直接关系”，在改善工资和工作条件方面更快、更有效。在 2010 年的一次投票中，达美航空的空乘人员拒绝加入工会。
“工会比一百年来更受欢迎，”尼尔森说。 “工会组织的时机已经成熟，我认为我们将在南方看到重大胜利。”
近年来，美国大多数主要航空公司的空乘人员都签署了新合同，薪资大幅上涨。她补充道，其中许多交易“由于新冠疫情而晚了四、五年、六年”。
尼尔森表示，这轮融资可能会带来稳定的收益，但不会像过去那样大幅上涨——这是设计使然。
“如果我们能够回到谈判桌，减少问题数量并更定期地谈判这些合同，航空公司员工的工资就会定期增加，”尼尔森说。 “你不会有这些巨大的跳跃，然后你就不会有竞争对手担心他们的竞争对手何时必须支付这些巨大的增长费用的问题。”
工会还期待与地区航空公司即将举行的一轮谈判取得重大胜利。
尼尔森说，支线空乘人员现在主要驻扎在芝加哥和纽约等昂贵的枢纽，但收入“基本上是干线空乘人员收入的一半”。大多数人还缺乏登机费，她说，由于平均飞行时间较短，支线航空公司的登机费大约相当于支线航空公司薪酬的 16%，而干线航空公司的登机费约为 8%。
AFA 于 11 月 13 日重返与美国航空子公司 PSA 航空的谈判，并于 12 月开始与达美航空旗下的奋进航空进行谈判，尼尔森表示达美航空“有足够的现金来支付”约 1,700 名空乘人员的工资。
寄宿费正在慢慢成为整个行业的标准。在加拿大，加拿大航空的机组人员于 2025 年 8 月因无薪地面工作而举行罢工，并于 2 月份确保了登机费，西捷航空的空乘人员今年夏天也因同样的问题而罢工。在美国，达美航空于 2022 年开始支付登机费用，美国航空和阿拉斯加航空的合同现已包含此项服务。
尼尔森说：“乘客们第一次得知空乘人员在此期间没有拿到工资，因此公众感到愤怒。” “公众站在我们这边。所以他们不可能挽回。”
民主党中期选举大获全胜后，空乘人员工会首次出现在 FlightGlobal 上。

title_en: Citing loss-of-control risk, EASA orders additional ATR de-icing system checks
title_zh: EASA 以失控风险为由，下令对 ATR 除冰系统进行额外检查
summary: The European Union Aviation Safety Agency (EASA) has ordered operators of ATR 42 and ATR 72 turboprops to… The post Citing loss-of-control risk, EASA orders additional ATR de-icing system checks appeared first on AeroTime .
summary_zh: 欧盟航空安全局 (EASA) 已命令 ATR 42 和 ATR 72 涡轮螺旋桨飞机的运营商……
body_en: The European Union Aviation Safety Agency (EASA) has ordered operators of ATR 42 and ATR 72 turboprops to check their de-icing systems as often as every 160 flight hours, warning that a valve failure could go undetected until an aircraft encounters icing and lead to an unrecoverable loss of control.

The airworthiness directive, issued November 16, 2026, takes effect November 30. EASA had already shortened the time between checks in January 2025 after a design review identified the risk. A subsequent analysis of how the valves could fail prompted ATR to revise its maintenance instructions again in October.

Brazilian investigators identified ice buildup and multiple de-icing system failures among the factors that contributed to the August 9, 2024, crash of Voepass Flight 2283 . All 62 people aboard the ATR 72-500 died when it crashed in Vinhedo, Brazil. ATR issued its first notice to operators about the valve checks in October 2024, about two months after the accident.

The order covers the valves that regulate pressure and shut off the air supply to the de-icing system. How often operators must test them depends on the aircraft model and whether ATR modified it at the factory or an operator had the work done later.

The biggest change is for modified ATR 42-400s, ATR 42-500s and ATR 72s. Under the January 2025 order, those aircraft could fly up to 1,050 hours between checks. The new limit is 160 hours, an 85% reduction. For aircraft of the same models without the modification, the interval drops from 700 hours to 210. Operators of the earlier ATR 42-200, -300 and -320 models will have to check the valves every 190 hours, down from 650.

If a valve fails a check, the operator must correct the problem before the aircraft flies again. If ATR’s published instructions do not cover the fault, the operator must obtain approved instructions from the manufacturer and carry out the work.
The post Citing loss-of-control risk, EASA orders additional ATR de-icing system checks appeared first on AeroTime .
body_zh: 欧盟航空安全局 (EASA) 已命令 ATR 42 和 ATR 72 涡轮螺旋桨飞机的运营商每 160 个飞行小时检查一次除冰系统，警告称阀门故障可能不会被发现，直到飞机遇到结冰并导致无法恢复的失控。
该适航指令于 2026 年 11 月 16 日发布，将于 11 月 30 日生效。在设计审查发现风险后，EASA 已于 2025 年 1 月缩短了检查间隔时间。随后对阀门故障原因的分析促使 ATR 在 10 月份再次修改其维护说明。
巴西调查人员发现，积冰和多个除冰系统故障是导致 2024 年 8 月 9 日 Voepass 2283 航班坠毁的因素之一。 ATR 72-500 在巴西维涅多坠毁，机上 62 人全部遇难。 ATR 于 2024 年 10 月（即事故发生大约两个月后）向运营商发出了关于阀门检查的第一份通知。
该订单涵盖调节压力和关闭除冰系统供气的阀门。运营商必须多久进行一次测试取决于飞机型号以及 ATR 是否在工厂对其进行了修改，或者运营商后来完成了工作。

最大的变化是修改后的 ATR 42-400、ATR 42-500 和 ATR 72。根据 2025 年 1 月的命令，这些飞机在两次检查之间最多可以飞行 1,050 小时。新的限制为 160 小时，减少了 85%。对于未经改装的相同型号飞机，间隔时间从 700 小时减少到 210 小时。早期 ATR 42-200、-300 和 -320 型号的操作员必须每 190 小时检查一次阀门，从 650 小时减少。
如果阀门未通过检查，操作员必须在飞机再次飞行之前纠正问题。如果 ATR 发布的说明未涵盖故障，则操作员必须获得制造商批准的说明并进行工作。
该帖子以失控风险为由，EASA 下令对 ATR 除冰系统进行额外检查，该帖子首先出现在 AeroTime 上。

title_en: $3.4 Billion: Boeing Finalizes Order For Up To 20 787-10s From Philippine Airlines

summary: The Dreamliner will be only the second Boeing aircraft type operated by the airline, joining the 777.

body_en: Jack comes to Simple Flying with a lifelong interest in all things aviation. He holds a degree in Aerospace Engineering from Georgia Tech, and is a certified private and remote pilot. Beyond these experiences, Jack previously worked for a corporate flight department where he gained first-hand experience in the world of business aviation. Philippine Airlines has finalized contracts with Boeing for 15 Boeing 787-10 Dreamliners, with purchase rights for five additional aircraft, completing a deal that could cover up to 20 widebodies. The agreement , announced on November 15, is the largest widebody purchase in the Philippine flag carrier’s history. The aircraft will be powered by GE Aerospace GEnx-1B engines and are intended to support fleet modernization and growth across medium- and long-haul routes.

Earlier this year, Reuters reported an estimated headline value of $3.4 billion if all 20 aircraft are acquired, based on post-discount pricing estimates reported by Reuters in July. Boeing and Philippine Airlines have not disclosed the finalized contract value. The firm commitment is for 15 aircraft, while the remaining five are not firm orders. The agreements were signed on November 10, converting a commitment first announced at the Farnborough International Airshow in July into definitive contracts.
15 Aircraft Are Firmly Ordered, With Five More Available

The November contracts formalize Philippine Airlines' July commitment for 15 Boeing 787-10s and the opportunity to acquire five more. The five additional aircraft remain purchase rights, not guaranteed deliveries. If exercised, they would bring the total to 20. GE Aerospace's GEnx-1B engines are included in the agreements, giving the aircraft a confirmed propulsion supplier. The selection extends a relationship between GE and Philippine Airlines that spans more than five decades. The GEnx family is also used on Boeing 787 variants operated by other international carriers, providing an established engine platform rather than introducing a new type into the airline's maintenance planning.

Deliveries are scheduled for the next decade, although the latest announcement did not provide a detailed timetable. Reuters reported in July that deliveries were expected to begin in 2031, while Philippine Airlines' November announcement used the broader timeframe. The airline has not identified individual delivery years or specified when the five additional purchase rights might be exercised. The order is therefore a long-term commitment rather than an immediate capacity increase. Philippine Airlines will need to plan aircraft financing, crew training, maintenance arrangements, and fleet transitions well ahead of the first arrival.
The 787-10 Adds Capacity To Philippine Airlines' Widebody Fleet

As the largest member of the 787 family, the 787-10 is designed to carry more passengers than the smaller 787-8 and 787-9. Boeing lists a typical passenger capacity of 300 to 375, depending on cabin configuration. Its composite airframe and modern systems are designed to improve fuel efficiency compared with older-generation widebodies.

Boeing says the 787 family uses approximately 25% less fuel than the aircraft it typically replaces. Actual savings depend on route length, passenger load, cabin layout, and operating conditions, but improved efficiency can help airlines reduce costs on fuel-intensive international services . The aircraft also offers passenger features associated with the Dreamliner family, including larger dimmable windows, higher cabin humidity, and systems designed to reduce the effects of turbulence.

The 787-10's larger capacity makes it particularly relevant to routes with substantial demand. However, it does not have the same range capability as the smaller 787-9, meaning Philippine Airlines will need to match the aircraft to suitable markets rather than assume it can serve every long-haul destination in its network. The airline has not announced which routes will receive the new type or disclosed its planned seating configuration.
Fleet Renewal Extends Beyond The Boeing Order

Dreamliners will form part of a broader modernization strategy as Philippine Airlines prepares to replace older widebody aircraft and support international growth. The carrier currently operates Boeing 777s alongside Airbus A330s and A350s. Adding the 787-10 will introduce another widebody type, but its capacity and efficiency could provide a replacement option for older aircraft as they approach the end of their service lives or lease agreements.

The Boeing purchase also follows Philippine Airlines' July announcement of a separate agreement with Airbus. The airline signed a memorandum of understanding for nine A350-1000s , with purchase rights for five additional aircraft. That proposal is separate from the finalized Boeing contract and is intended to strengthen the carrier's ability to serve its longest international routes. The two programs suggest a differentiated fleet strategy. The 787-10 can provide substantial capacity on medium- and long-haul services, while the larger-range A350-1000 is suited to longer intercontinental operations. This approach gives Philippine Airlines options for matching aircraft size and performance to different markets rather than relying on one widebody model.

Beyond the aircraft deliveries, the Boeing agreement also reinforces an 80-year relationship between the manufacturer and the Philippine flag carrier. For Boeing, the finalized purchase adds a significant widebody customer commitment in Southeast Asia. For Philippine Airlines, the aircraft will represent a major investment in its next-generation fleet, although the full benefits will not materialize until deliveries begin in the 2030s.

body_zh: Jack 带着对航空一切事物的终生兴趣加入了 Simple Flying。他拥有佐治亚理工学院的航空航天工程学位，并且是一名经过认证的私人和远程飞行员。除了这些经验之外，杰克还曾在公司飞行部门工作过，在那里他获得了公务航空领域的第一手经验。目前，杰克在专业服务行业工作，并在工作之外继续增加飞行时间。
菲律宾航空已与波音公司敲定了 15 架波音 787-10 梦想飞机的合同，并拥有另外 5 架飞机的购买权，完成的交易可能涵盖多达 20 架宽体飞机。该协议于 11 月 15 日宣布，是菲律宾旗舰航空公司历史上最大的宽体机采购。该飞机将由 GE Aerospace GEnx-1B 发动机提供动力，旨在支持机队现代化和中长途航线的增长。
今年早些时候，路透社报道称，根据路透社 7 月份报道的折后定价估计，如果收购全部 20 架飞机，预计总价值将达到 34 亿美元。波音和菲律宾航空尚未透露最终合同价值。确定订单为15架，其余5架为非确定订单。这些协议于 11 月 10 日签署，将 7 月份范堡罗国际航展上首次宣布的承诺转化为最终合同。
15 架飞机已确认订购，还有 5 架可供订购

11 月份的合同正式确定了菲律宾航空公司 7 月份购买 15 架波音 787-10 飞机的承诺，并有机会购买另外 5 架飞机。另外五架飞机仍保留购买权，但不保证交付。如果执行，总数将达到 20 台。GE 航空航天公司的 GEnx-1B 发动机包含在协议中，从而为该飞机提供了一个确定的推进供应商。此次选择进一步拓展了 GE 与菲律宾航空之间长达 50 多年的合作关系。 GEnx 系列还用于其他国际航空公司运营的波音 787 改型，提供成熟的发动机平台，而不是在航空公司的维护计划中引入新型发动机。
波音与菲律宾航空 (PAL) 关系概览
菲律宾武装部队运营的 ScanEagle 系统
交付计划在未来十年进行，尽管最新公告没有提供详细的时间表。路透社 7 月报道称，预计将于 2031 年开始交付，而菲律宾航空公司 11 月的声明则使用了更广泛的时间范围。该航空公司尚未确定具体的交付年份或具体说明何时可以行使五项额外的购买权。因此，该订单是一项长期承诺，而不是立即增加产能。菲律宾航空公司需要在飞机首次抵达之前就计划好飞机融资、机组人员培训、维护安排和机队转换。
787-10 为菲律宾航空公司的宽体机队增加了运力
作为 787 家族中最大的成员，787-10 的设计比较小的 787-8 和 787-9 运载更多乘客。波音公司列出的典型载客量为 300 至 375 人，具体取决于客舱配置。与老一代宽体飞机相比，其复合材料机身和现代系统旨在提高燃油效率。
波音公司表示，787 系列飞机的燃油消耗量比其通常替代的飞机少约 25%。实际节省的成本取决于航线长度、乘客载量、客舱布局和运营条件，但提高效率可以帮助航空公司降低燃油密集型国际服务的成本。该飞机还提供与梦想飞机系列相关的乘客功能，包括更大的可调光窗户、更高的机舱湿度以及旨在减少湍流影响的系统。
787-10 的运力更大，使其特别适用于需求量大的航线。然而，它不具有与较小的 787-9 相同的航程能力，这意味着菲律宾航空公司需要将飞机与合适的市场相匹配，而不是假设它可以为其网络中的每个长途目的地提供服务。该航空公司尚未宣布哪些航线将采用新型机型，也没有透露其计划的座位配置。
机队更新超出了波音订单范围
随着菲律宾航空公司准备更换旧的宽体飞机并支持国际增长，梦想飞机将成为更广泛的现代化战略的一部分。该航空公司目前运营波音 777 飞机以及空客 A330 和 A350 飞机。增加 787-10 将引入另一种宽体机型，但其容量和效率可以为旧飞机在其使用寿命或租赁协议即将结束时提供替代选择。

菲律宾航空公司7月份宣布与空中客车公司签署单独协议后，波音公司也进行了收购。该航空公司签署了购买 9 架 A350-1000 飞机的谅解备忘录，并拥有另外 5 架飞机的购买权。该提案与最终确定的波音合同无关，旨在增强该航空公司为其最长国际航线提供服务的能力。这两个计划提出了差异化的机队战略。 787-10 可以为中远程服务提供大量运力，而航程更大的 A350-1000 则适合更长的洲际运营。这种方法为菲律宾航空公司提供了将飞机尺寸和性能与不同市场相匹配的选择，而不是依赖于一种宽体机型。
除了飞机交付之外，波音协议还巩固了制造商与菲律宾旗舰航空公司之间长达 80 年的关系。对于波音来说，最终的购买增加了对东南亚宽体客机的重要承诺。对于菲律宾航空公司来说，这架飞机将是对其下一代机队的重大投资，尽管其全部效益要到 2030 年代开始交付才能实现。

body_en: James lives and breathes route development. Educated in Air Transport Management at Loughborough University and Cranfield University, James has a PhD in Airline Strategy and Economics. James was Market Opportunity Analyst at London Luton Airport and Chief Analyst at anna.aero. He taught airline strategy and economics to undergraduate and postgraduate students for five years and has worked closely with multiple carriers on route and market intelligence projects. Between November 21 and December 17, Air Canada and its lower-cost unit Rouge will collectively launch or restart 22 international routes . They won't just be from the Star Alliance member's primary hubs of Toronto Pearson, Montreal, and Vancouver. They'll also be from Calgary, Edmonton, Halifax, Ottawa, Quebec City, and Winnipeg.

For obvious reasons, none of the routes are to Europe. Instead, they're primarily to the Caribbean, Central America, and Mexico for warm winter weather. It is possible that some of the links to the Caribbean are materializing because the airline no longer flies to Cuba.
Eight International Routes Will Launch From November 21 To December 5

Half of the routes have not previously been served by the airline, at least in the last 22 years and possibly ever. Most of the others return after an absence of at least a decade. They include from Winnipeg to the ever-popular tourist destination of Punta Cana. At 2,334 nautical miles (4,323 km) each way, it'll be Air Canada's new longest route from the capital of Manitoba in more than a fifth of a century.

At 1,769 nautical miles (3,276 km), Vancouver to Monterrey will be Air Canada's new longest international Airbus A220-300 market from British Columbia. However, it will not be the equipment's longest-ever service from Vancouver past the Canadian border. The carrier deployed the narrowbody from Vancouver to Raleigh-Durham until June 2026 and Nashville until three months later, but those routes have since ended .

These Seven Links Will Begin Between December 6 & December 11

They include Vancouver to the growing Mexican tourist destination of Puerto Escondido, which is a market that has not previously had flights with any airline. It is, therefore, particularly notable. OAG data shows that Vancouver will have flights to 11 destinations in Mexico this winter, provided by Aeromexico , Air Canada, Flair, and WestJet. With 31% of the departures, Air Canada is the second-largest operator, after WestJet.

Some broader context is needed for Puerto Escondido, which is particularly well-known for surfing. Vancouver will be the third nonstop market from Canada, after those by Air Canada from Toronto (which launched in December 2025) and WestJet from Calgary (December 2025).

They followed the start of the first route from the USA to Puerto Escondido in April 2025. This was United Airlines from Houston, while American Airlines followed from Dallas in December last year. All the new routes were influenced by the airport's infrastructure improvements , with significant further development underway to accommodate the much greater traffic .
Seven International Routes Will Take Off From December 12 To December 17

All but one of the following links will be new to Air Canada's network. At a considerable 2,976 nautical miles (5,512 km), Vancouver to the increasingly popular Costa Rican destination of Liberia will become the Star Alliance member's longest narrowbody operation from British Columbia. More than that, it'll be the operator's longest-ever service on the Boeing 737 MAX 8, exceeding the distance of all transatlantic routes on the variant.

The most notable market is, of course, from Vancouver to Sapporo, which will become the airline's new shortest route to Asia . Sapporo is known for winter activities, including skiing and other snow-based adventures. Air Canada will now have ten routes from Vancouver to Asia this winter, although flights to Singapore will end in January 2027 .

Southwest Airlines is the USA's and the world's fourth-largest operator for flights in November 2026. OAG data indicates that the increasingly evolving carrier, which rightly calls itself a hybrid airline nowadays , has 4,052 services a day.

The carrier's activity has jumped by 4% year-over-year, with 168 additional daily movements added. However, Southwest remains nearly 3% smaller than it was in November 2023. Despite this, multiple new routes are coming, with five launching on one day this week, including new transcontinental operations.

The airline's entire schedule between November 16 and 22 was examined, which identified that five routes will begin in this period. body_en: United Airlines system outage disrupts departures - Aviation24.be

United Airlines reported a widespread system outage affecting departing flights on Monday, 16 November 2026. The airline said flights already airborne and services operated by its regional network, United Express, were unaffected.

FlightAware listed 418 delayed United flights late Monday afternoon, the Associated Press reported. That was the airline’s overall delay count at the time. The number attributable to the outage was unclear. United said it was working to restore operations and had yet to confirm the cause or announce a full recovery.

The FAA told CNN it was aware of the outage and referred questions to United. The disruption came three days after an FAA telecommunications failure prompted a nationwide ground stop. No link between the two incidents has been established.

body_en: Journalist – Aaron is an aviation and travel journalist with 14 years of experience in the travel and tourism industry. The world's largest airline by fleet size, United Airlines, is experiencing a widespread system outage, just days after the US faced a nationwide ground stop. United has confirmed that it was experiencing the system outage on Monday afternoon, and this has affected departing flights. Flights in progress or those operated by United Express are not affected at this time.

In a memo by the union representing United pilots, the union has outlined that the system issue assists with calculating the airline's weight and balance, which restricts the outbound flights when they are unable to calculate the final weights. Simple Flying has reached out to United for comment on the matter; however, an airline spokesperson could not be reached.

"We are troubleshooting a technology issue affecting departing flights. There is no impact on flights in progress or on United Express flights."

Air traffic control audio that has been obtained by NBC Chicago noted that United flights were reporting issues with receiving their takeoff numbers. CBS News has also shared a recording posted on an ATC app in which United pilots asked the tower for permission to stay at the gate until the system was working again.

title_en: From Texas To France: Southwest Expands Global Reach With New French bee Partnership
title_zh: 从德克萨斯州到法国：西南航空通过新的法国蜜蜂合作伙伴关系扩大全球影响力
summary: Southwest's latest interline deal opens connections to Paris, Tahiti and the Indian Ocean while strengthening French bee's US reach.
summary_zh: 西南航空最新的联运协议开辟了与巴黎、塔希提岛和印度洋的航线，同时加强了法国蜜蜂在美国的影响力。
body_en: Paul has had a career of 25+ years focused on the international technology sector, which has taken him to over 100 countries. Along the way, he developed a deep love for aviation, with a travel bucket list measured by aircraft types flown rather than destinations reached. Now he brings that avgeek passion, along with the journalism experience he accumulated early in his career, to write insightful pieces for Simple Flying.

Southwest Airlines has announced a new international interline partnership with French bee , allowing passengers to combine flights on both carriers under a single ticket. The new agreement provides connections through Los Angeles International Airport (LAX), Miami International Airport (MIA), and San Francisco International Airport (SFO), linking Southwest's domestic network with French bee's long-haul services to Europe and beyond.

French bee becomes Southwest's 12th international airline partner, continuing a remarkable expansion of the carrier's overseas connectivity since its first agreement with Icelandair in early 2025 . The partnership comes as French bee prepares to expand into two new Asian markets, opening additional travel opportunities for Southwest passengers.
Southwest And French Bee Launch New Interline Partnership

The new partnership takes effect immediately , with bookings available through French bee, travel agents and third-party booking platforms. Southwest Executive Vice President and Chief Commercial Officer Justin Jones welcomed the agreement, highlighting the opportunity to expand the airline's international reach without operating long-haul flights itself.
"French bee shares our philosophy of pairing value with a welcoming travel experience, and this partnership opens new possibilities for travelers to connect across oceans on a single ticket."

Unlike a codeshare, an interline agreement allows airlines to coordinate connecting itineraries and checked baggage without placing their flight numbers on each other's services. Passengers therefore benefit from a single booking. However, it's worth noting that interline tickets are not yet available through Southwest.com, and reciprocal loyalty earning and redemption are also not included.

French bee, owned by Groupe Dubreuil, operates an all-Airbus A350 fleet from its Paris-Orly base. Its existing network includes Newark, Los Angeles, Miami, San Francisco, Montreal, Réunion Island and Tahiti. It is also famous for operating the world's longest nonstop domestic route , from Paris to Roland Garros Airport (RUN) in Saint-Denis de la Réunion, covering 5,048 nautical miles (5,810 statute miles / 9,349 km).

For Southwest, the partnership provides access to destinations far beyond its Boeing 737 network, including Paris and French Polynesia. French bee is also preparing to launch new routes to the Maldives and Sri Lanka on December 19. Initially, the services will operate via a triangular Orly–Malé–Colombo–Orly routing, with additional nonstop Paris-Colombo flights beginning January 11, 2027. The table below highlights French bee's existing and upcoming routes, including services beyond Southwest's three US connecting gateways.

French bee also stands to benefit from access to Southwest's extensive domestic network , with travelers originating from other US cities able to connect through Los Angeles, Miami or San Francisco onto French bee's long-haul flights. This additional feeder traffic is particularly valuable to a relatively small long-haul airline seeking to improve load factors and reduce its dependence on passengers originating in its three US gateway markets.

Looking further ahead, the partnership could also strengthen the business case for French bee to launch additional US routes. Aviation Week reports that the airline is actively examining new destinations in the US and Asia to reduce seasonal fluctuations in demand. Cities like Las Vegas and Orlando could therefore be particularly interesting candidates, given Southwest's strong presence in both cities and with them being substantial leisure markets.
Southwest's Growing Network Of International Partners

Southwest's international partnership strategy began when it signed its first agreement with Icelandair in January last year, with operations beginning the following month. Since then, agreements with multiple Asian and European airlines have rapidly expanded its international reach, including with global giants such as Turkish Airlines and Singapore Airlines .

The following table shows all 12 international interline partners and their designated US connecting airports, according to Southwest's official partnership directory and interline partner information .

Boston, Las Vegas, Los Angeles, Portland, San Francisco, Seattle
Baltimore, Denver, Nashville, Orlando, Pittsburgh, Raleigh-Durham
Atlanta, Boston, Denver, Detroit, Los Angeles, Miami, San Francisco, Seattle

The partnerships are also starting to evolve beyond basic interline arrangements. In October, Southwest and Icelandair announced an expansion of their loyalty partnership , allowing reciprocal points earning and redemption from Spring 2027. With further international agreements under consideration, Southwest is increasingly positioning itself as a feeder airline for global carriers, gaining long-haul connectivity without the costs and complexities of operating widebody aircraft.
body_zh: Paul 拥有超过 25 年的职业生涯，专注于国际技术领域，足迹遍及 100 多个国家。一路走来，他对航空产生了深深的热爱，他的旅行愿望清单是根据飞行的飞机类型而不是到达的目的地来衡量的。现在，他带着这种平均极客的热情，以及他在职业生涯早期积累的新闻经验，为《简单飞行》撰写了富有洞察力的文章。
西南航空宣布与法国蜜蜂航空建立新的国际联运合作伙伴关系，允许乘客在一张机票下合并两家航空公司的航班。新协议提供了洛杉矶国际机场 (LAX)、迈阿密国际机场 (MIA) 和旧金山国际机场 (SFO) 的转机服务，将西南航空的国内网络与 French Bee 飞往欧洲及其他地区的长途服务连接起来。
法国蜜蜂航空成为西南航空的第 12 个国际航空公司合作伙伴，自 2025 年初与冰岛航空签订第一份协议以来，该航空公司的海外连接持续显着扩张。此次合作正值法国蜜蜂准备拓展两个新的亚洲市场，为西南航空的乘客提供更多的旅行机会。
西南航空与 French Bee 建立新的联运合作伙伴关系
新的合作伙伴关系立即生效，可通过法国蜜蜂、旅行社和第三方预订平台进行预订。西南航空执行副总裁兼首席商务官贾斯汀·琼斯对这项协议表示欢迎，并强调了该公司在不运营长途航班的情况下扩大国际影响力的机会。
“French bee 与我们有着相同的理念，即将价值与温馨的旅行体验相结合，这种合作关系为旅行者通过一张机票跨越大洋的旅程开辟了新的可能性。”
与代码共享不同，联运协议允许航空公司协调转机行程和托运行李，而无需将航班号放在彼此的服务上。因此，乘客只需一次预订即可受益。但值得注意的是，Southwest.com 尚未提供联运机票，并且互惠忠诚度赚取和兑换也不包括在内。
French bee 隶属于 Groupe Dubreuil，在巴黎奥利机场运营着一支全空客 A350 机队。其现有网络包括纽瓦克、洛杉矶、迈阿密、旧金山、蒙特利尔、留尼汪岛和塔希提岛。该公司还因运营世界上最长的直飞国内航线而闻名，从巴黎飞往留尼汪岛圣但尼罗兰加洛斯机场 (RUN)，航线全长 5,048 海里（5,810 法定英里/9,349 公里）。

对于西南航空来说，此次合作将使其能够飞往远远超出其波音 737 网络范围的目的地，包括巴黎和法属波利尼西亚。 French bee 还准备于 12 月 19 日开通飞往马尔代夫和斯里兰卡的新航线。最初，这些服务将通过奥利 - 马累 - 科伦坡 - 奥利三角航线运营，并从 2027 年 1 月 11 日开始增加巴黎 - 科伦坡直达航班。下表重点介绍了 French bee 现有和即将开通的航线，包括西南航空三个美国转机门户以外的航班。
法国蜜蜂航空还受益于西南航空广泛的国内网络，来自美国其他城市的旅客可以通过洛杉矶、迈阿密或旧金山转乘法国蜜蜂航空的长途航班。对于一家规模相对较小的长途航空公司来说，这种额外的支线运输量尤其有价值，该航空公司希望提高载客率并减少对源自其三个美国门户市场的乘客的依赖。
展望未来，此次合作还可以加强法国蜜蜂开辟更多美国航线的商业理由。 《航空周刊》报道称，该航空公司正在积极研究美国和亚洲的新目的地，以减少需求的季节性波动。因此，考虑到西南航空在拉斯维加斯和奥兰多等城市的强大影响力以及庞大的休闲市场，像拉斯维加斯和奥兰多这样的城市可能是特别有趣的候选城市。
西南航空不断壮大的国际合作伙伴网络
西南航空的国际合作战略始于去年一月与冰岛航空签署第一份协议，并于次月开始运营。此后，与多家亚洲和欧洲航空公司签订的协议迅速扩大了其国际影响力，其中包括土耳其航空和新加坡航空等全球巨头。

title_en: Here's How The Boeing 757-300 Protects Its Ultra-Long Fuselage On Rotation In The Cockpit & Externally
title_zh: 以下是波音 757-300 如何在驾驶舱内和外部旋转时保护其超长机身
summary: Boeing's longest 757 came with an unusual engineering challenge. Its solution involved a small device beneath the tail and more than meets the eye.
summary_zh: 波音最长的 757 面临着不同寻常的工程挑战。它的解决方案是在尾巴下方安装一个小装置，其作用远不止表面上看到的那样。
body_en: Passionate about promoting aviation, the beauty of flight and the science behind it, Antonio is an avid reader of aviation magazines and books, and he loves visiting airshows all over the world, taking photos and writing about airplanes and helicopters as well. He is currently based in Palermo, Sicily.

At 178 feet, seven inches (54.43 meters), the Boeing 757-300 is the longest single-aisle twinjet ever built. Yet its extra length created an unexpected engineering challenge that had little to do with seats, range, landing gear, or engines. It was the runway . Boeing stretched the 757-200 by 23 feet, four inches (7.11 meters), and every extra foot behind the main landing gear increased the distance between the aircraft's pivot point and its tail, making ground clearance during rotation a critical consideration.

So how does an airplane so long get airborne without tail strikes? Boeing's answer is layered: a crushable tailskid, a sensor that tells the crew when the fuselage itself has touched the ground, a pitch cue on the attitude display, and a quiet change to the elevator controls that most passengers will never know exists. Understanding why Boeing needed several layers, and why one of them lives entirely in the pilot's hands, explains how a 178-foot airplane earns its nickname without earning a reputation for dragging its tail.
The 757-300’s Extra Length Made Tail Protection Essential

The problem starts with a simple geometric disadvantage. According to Ready For Take-Off Book , Boeing built the -300 by inserting a 13-foot, four-inch (4.06-meter) plug ahead of the wing, and a 10-foot (3.05-meter) plug behind it, leaving a fuselage 23 feet, four inches (7.11 meters) longer than the 757-200's 155 feet, three inches (47.32 meters).

That aft plug is particularly important during rotation. As the nose pitches upward, the airplane pivots around the main landing gear. The farther the tail extends behind that pivot point, the more quickly it moves toward the runway. The situation required Boeing to account for what that extra fuselage would do during the most critical seconds of takeoff.

Weight and speed make the geometry less forgiving. Boeing's own airport planning document lists a maximum design takeoff weight of 270,000 pounds (122,449 kg) for the 757-300, along with engines rated at 43,100 pounds of thrust (about 192 kN) for the Rolls-Royce RB211-535E4B and 43,850 pounds (about 195 kN) for the Pratt & Whitney PW2043.

The longer fuselage also meant Boeing had to protect the aft structure against a tail strike. When Condor became the 757-300's launch customer, Boeing incorporated structural reinforcement in the rear fuselage to accommodate the protection system fitted beneath the tail. The aircraft's greater length and higher rotation speeds made that additional protection particularly important during takeoff.

The program also moved quickly. Ready For Take-Off Book dates Condor's launch order to September 2, 1996, and the first flight to August 2, 1998, leaving little room for design surprises. The structure around the tail had to be prepared before the airplane ever reached the runway. But strengthening the fuselage was only the first layer. What actually hangs under that tail, waiting to take the hit?
The 757-300 Uses A Crushable Tailskid As Its First Line Of Defense

As detailed in the 757 technical reference , the tailskid is a retractable, crushable cartridge that extends for takeoff and landing and folds away in flight, shielding the pressurized part of the fuselage from the runway. The system is powered by the left hydraulic system and rides on the main landing gear actuation system, so extension happens automatically with gear selection. That makes the skid part of the airplane's normal configuration rather than something the crew has to deploy separately before every takeoff and landing. There is an important difference between the 757-300 and other Boeing widebody/narrowbody design detailed here: the 767-300's skid uses a compressible oleo strut, while the 757-300 relies on a crushable cartridge.

That distinction explains what happens if the skid actually makes contact. The cartridge is supposed to deform and absorb energy that would otherwise be transmitted into the airframe. Instead of asking the fuselage structure to take the entire impact, Boeing gives the impact a sacrificial component.

Even a contact leaves evidence behind: a red pop-out indicator at the bottom of the shock absorber shows whether the drag shoe touched the runway, and maintenance crews then check the cartridge through two inspection holes. What could have been a structural repair may instead be handled as an inspection item. One caveat: the skid does not extend when the alternate gear extension system is used. That detail becomes important because the tail skid itself is not the complete tail-strike protection system. Boeing also had to tell the crew when the airplane had gone beyond what the skid was designed to absorb.
Boeing Gave The 757-300 Separate Warnings For The Skid And The Airframe

Once the physical protection is in place, the next question becomes one of information. A pilot cannot always know from the cockpit whether a brief scrape involved only the skid or whether the fuselage itself contacted the runway. That is why the 757 uses separate indications for those two situations: per the 757 technical reference , a TAILSKID light and an Engine Indication and Crew Alerting System (EICAS) advisory appear whenever the skid’s position disagrees with the landing gear lever.

That tells the crew about the hardware. The airplane also has a separate tail-strike indication system in the aft body that detects ground contact capable of damaging the pressure hull. When that system detects contact, it posts a caution-level TAIL STRIKE message on the EICAS. A tail strike indication system installed in the aft body detects ground contact that could damage the pressure hull, and it posts a caution-level TAIL STRIKE message on the EICAS.

In practical terms, the red pop-out indicator is useful after the aircraft is back on the ground, while the cockpit indications tell the crew what the airplane believes happened. Ready For Take-Off Book also lists a body-contact indicator and modified spoiler logic among the -300's identifying features.
From the maintenance side, the Scribd-hosted Advanced Maintenance Techniques for the 757 document and a long-running Airliners.net tailskid discussion provide additional context.
body_zh: 安东尼奥热衷于推广航空、飞行之美及其背后的科学，是航空杂志和书籍的狂热读者，他喜欢参观世界各地的航展，也喜欢拍摄有关飞机和直升机的照片和撰写有关飞机和直升机的文章。他目前居住在西西里岛巴勒莫。
波音 757-300 长 178 英尺 7 英寸（54.43 米），是有史以来最长的单通道双喷气式飞机。然而，它的额外长度带来了意想不到的工程挑战，与座椅、航程、起落架或发动机无关。那是跑道。波音将 757-200 延长了 23 英尺 4 英寸（7.11 米），主起落架后面每增加一英尺就会增加飞机枢轴点与其尾部之间的距离，从而使旋转过程中的离地间隙成为一个关键考虑因素。
那么，这么长时间的飞机是如何在没有尾翼撞击的情况下升空的呢？波音公司的答案是分层的：可压碎的尾橇、告诉机组人员机身何时接触地面的传感器、姿态显示器上的俯仰提示，以及大多数乘客永远不会知道的电梯控制装置的安静变化。了解为什么波音需要多层，以及为什么其中一层完全掌握在飞行员手中，就可以解释一架 178 英尺长的飞机如何赢得它的绰号，而不赢得拖着尾巴的名声。
757-300 的超长使得尾部保护必不可少
问题始于一个简单的几何劣势。根据 Ready For Take-Off Book 的报道，波音在制造 -300 时，在机翼前面插入了一个 13 英尺 4 英寸（4.06 米）的插头，在机翼后面插入了一个 10 英尺（3.05 米）的插头，使机身比 757-200 的 155 英尺 3 英寸（47.32 米）长了 23 英尺 4 英寸（7.11 米）。
后塞在旋转过程中尤其重要。当机头向上倾斜时，飞机围绕主起落架旋转。尾部在枢轴点后面延伸得越远，它向跑道移动的速度就越快。这种情况要求波音公司考虑额外的机身在起飞的最关键时刻会做什么。
重量和速度使几何形状变得不那么宽容。波音自己的机场规划文件列出了 757-300 的最大设计起飞重量为 270,000 磅（122,449 千克），劳斯莱斯 RB211-535E4B 的发动机额定推力为 43,100 磅（约 192 kN），普惠公司的发动机额定推力为 43,850 磅（约 195 kN） PW2043。

机身较长还意味着波音必须保护机尾结构免受机尾撞击。当秃鹰成为 757-300 的首发客户时，波音在机身后部加入了结构加固，以容纳安装在尾部下方的保护系统。该飞机更长的长度和更高的旋转速度使得额外的保护在起飞过程中尤为重要。
该计划也进展迅速。 《准备起飞》书将秃鹰的发射订单日期定为 1996 年 9 月 2 日，首飞日期定为 1998 年 8 月 2 日，几乎没有留下设计惊喜的空间。机尾周围的结构必须在飞机到达跑道之前准备好。但强化机身只是第一层。那条尾巴下面究竟挂着什么，等待着受到打击？
757-300 使用可压碎的尾橇作为其第一道防线

正如 757 技术参考资料中详细介绍的那样，尾橇是一个可伸缩、可压碎的筒，在起飞和着陆时可延伸，在飞行中可折叠起来，从而保护机身的加压部分免受跑道影响。该系统由左侧液压系统提供动力，并依靠主起落架驱动系统，因此在选择档位时会自动进行伸展。这使得滑行成为飞机正常配置的一部分，而不是机组人员在每次起飞和着陆之前必须单独部署的部分。 757-300 与此处详细介绍的其他波音宽体/窄体设计之间有一个重要区别：767-300 的滑橇使用可压缩的油压支柱，而 757-300 则依赖于可压碎的墨盒。
这种区别解释了如果滑板实际接触时会发生什么。该弹药筒应该会变形并吸收否则会传输到机身的能量。波音公司没有要求机身结构承受全部冲击力，而是为冲击力提供了一个牺牲部件。
即使是接触也会留下证据：减震器底部的红色弹出指示器显示拖板是否接触跑道，然后维护人员通过两个检查孔检查弹药筒。原本可能是结构修复的内容可能会作为检查项目进行处理。需要注意的是：当使用备用齿轮延伸系统时，滑橇不会延伸。这个细节变得很重要，因为尾橇本身并不是完整的尾部撞击保护系统。当飞机超出滑橇设计吸收能力时，波音公司还必须告诉机组人员。
波音公司对 757-300 的滑橇和机身分别发出警告
一旦物理保护到位，下一个问题就变成了信息问题。飞行员无法总能从驾驶舱知道短暂的刮擦是否仅涉及滑行，或者机身本身是否接触了跑道。这就是为什么 757 对这两种情况使用单独的指示：根据 757 技术参考，每当滑橇的位置与起落架杆不一致时，就会出现 TAILSKID 灯和发动机指示和机组人员警报系统 (EICAS) 咨询。
这告诉工作人员有关硬件的信息。该飞机还在后机身设有独立的尾部撞击指示系统，用于检测可能损坏耐压船体的地面接触。当该系统检测到接触时，它会在 EICAS 上发布警告级别的 TAIL STRIKE 消息。安装在后机身的尾部撞击指示系统检测到可能损坏耐压船体的地面接触，并在 EICAS 上发布警告级尾部撞击信息。
实际上，红色弹出指示器在飞机返回地面后很有用，而驾驶舱指示则告诉机组人员飞机认为发生了什么。 《准备起飞》书还在 -300 的识别功能中列出了身体接触指示器和修改后的扰流板逻辑。
从维护方面来看，Scribd 主办的 757 高级维护技术文档和长期运行的 Airliners.net tailskid 讨论提供了更多背景信息。

body_en: Thai Airways A350 diverts to New Delhi on Munich–Bangkok flight - Aviation24.be
Home Airports Bangkok Airport (BKK) Thai Airways A350 diverts to New Delhi on Munich–Bangkok flight

Thai Airways flight TG925 from Munich to Bangkok diverted to New Delhi after the crew detected a technical problem in flight. The Airbus A350-900 registered HS-THT departed Munich at 13:35 local time on 14 November 2026 and landed safely at Indira Gandhi International Airport. No injuries were reported.

Thai news outlet Khaosod English reported that the problem involved one of the engines and that spare parts were needed from Thailand. Thai Airways confirmed the precautionary diversion and described the fault as a technical issue without identifying the affected system.

The airline arranged hotel accommodation in New Delhi. A Thai Airways spokesperson told German newspaper tz that passengers reached Bangkok on Monday, 16 November , more than a day after their scheduled arrival.
